WELCOME TO EP KIRAMUTSE

EP KIRAMUTSE

EP Kiramutse is a primary school that is made of 6 rooms so far. it is built on Bethammi CFC’s Land at Nyaruguru Parish. 

This school was donated by the New City Fellowship Church led by Pastor Barry. The school is fully operational and is a source of Knowledge and skills for a lot of Kids in the neighbouring villages.

The school was in Need

This school was built while it was in need for Kids who used to travel miles and miles to reach a near by school.

Kids are now learning from a very short distance which is good for both their body and mind.

Home for Kids

EP Kiramutse is full fonctional and has basic materials to help kids learn and study. we have a team of teachers who are helping kids.

DONATE TO SUPPORT THIS SCHOOL

We are still relying on Donations to help this school run smoothly. Donate today to support this school and the little ones

Women Ministries

About Women Ministries

Women Ministries at Bethammi (WMB) is a ministry working in Bethammi Christian Fellowship Church that is made of Women around Bethammi Parishes.

Each Parish organizes its activities that are mainly related with Humanitarian Activities, Spiritual and Economic development.  WMB started its activities few months after the birth of Bethammi Christian Fellowship Church in 2007. This ministry has more than 1300 women around our parishes.  At Bethammi CFC, women are one of the Church Pillars and are doing a wonderful work of God

Women Under Ministry
1300 Women
Visiting those who are sick at Hospitals

Every first Monday of the week, the Bethammi Women cook delicious meal and go to Hospitals to visit those who are sick and have no means and give them food and if possible help pay for the Bills whenever possible. Not only that they share the word of God to console them and Bring hope to them.

Hospitals in Partnership
2 Hospitals
Times visited
100+
Plates
10K+
Bills Paid
1.5M+ Rwf
Helping Widows

widows are among those who are vulnerable that’s why Bethammi’s Women Minsitries is helping them through Humanitarian activities like: Providing to them Shelters and Foods. WMB is also helping them through the world of God that they share with them to comfort and empower them.

Widows
17%

200+

Spiritual Activities

At Bethammi we know that, after all, God is the First and we want to make sure that we are spiritually Growing and gaining. WMB organizes crusades, Prayers and trainings to help women grow in knowing God.

Crusades
230

180
Economic Activities

Women Ministries are organizing themselves to make sure that they stay Economically stable and make sure no vulnerable women among them. Even if it still tough but they are doing great through different activities like:

 

Handcraft: WMB is good at training Women to make jewelries. They are making very good and wonderful Jewelries made of simple materials. After making those, they sell them to both internal and external markets and is serving as the way of living. 

Handcrafts Sold
1200+

23

Vocational Training: we have different talents among us, and with a help of trainings, those talents feed their owners. WMB is providing trainings in Handcrafting, business and Tailoring.

Children Ministries

As described in our mission, we want show the love of God through concrete actions of human and social development, this has pushed us to create a program that can contribute to a positive transformation of community and specifically for vulnerable families and marginalized children using Child centered community development and self-help group approached

Children ministry is done at Beth Ammi Christian
fellowship church through the program whose main goal is to
improve standards of living of children and their families to fully exploit the available resources and reach their God given potentials for sustainable development. The program is based on a strategy that integrates four major projects namely basic education, food security, health and saving & credits projects in a composite implementation plan conceived to ensure delivery efficiencies and effectiveness with built-in monitoring, reporting, and continuous evaluation functions which provide a guarantee of standards and quality life of children.  Each project has its own goal contributing to the success of program goal.

We have 1,000 children beneficiaries that are supported to get basic
needs from the church like something to eat, clothes, teaching them the word of
God, being their advocacy in their needs. On events such as Christmas, children at Beth Ammi play games and drama and share the happy moments in between and with other children. They also share food at Christmas. 

We invite all those people who have the hearts of
goodwill for contributing anything which can transform the lives of the
children. As until now we are looking for partners who will be working with us
to see how these lovely children can be sent to school

We  have 1,000 vulnerable household
beneficiaries that we are supporting for self-reliance and development of their
families through food security, hand craft and saving and credit groups and
this is done for sustainability of the program activities, due to the fact that
there are the parents of the vulnerable children supported and once their
income is increased they will invest in basic needs of their children (food,
education and health

Beth Ammi means house of my people. It has found by Rev.Pastor Gatabazi Alfred where the first parish was established in 2007 and installed in Kigali City, Gasabo District, Rusororo Sector in Nyagahinga Cell; with a clear vision and mission which direct the Church to achieve its dream and impact of positive transformation for Rwandan community.

Bethammi currrently have 6 parishes in Rwanda and 3 parishes in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).

Beth Ammi is legally working in Rwanda under the ministerial order nº 07/08.11 of 08/02/2010

we believe that there is only one true God who is the eternal King, Creator and Redeemer of all. He is perfectly holy, just, loving and truthful. He has revealed Himself to be eternally self- existent – one being in three persons: God the Father, God the Son, and God the Holy Spirit.

Our Mission

 is to proclaim the gospel of salvation offered by God through His son Jesus Christ and to demonstrate the love of God through concrete actions of human and social development.

Our Vision

is to build a strong church which has members that are strong spiritually, able to testify the kingdom of God in the world.

The 7 Days of Holy Convocation at Beth Ammi Christian Fellowship Church continues today with Day 4, bringing together believers for a time of worship, fellowship, prayer and reflection on the Word of God.

The ongoing seven-day gathering is providing an opportunity for members of the Beth Ammi Christian Fellowship family and other believers to come together, seek God’s presence and strengthen their faith through worship, teaching and fellowship.

Day 4: A Time to Seek God’s Presence

Today’s program is taking place at Beth Ammi Christian Fellowship Church, Kabuga Parish, beginning at 3:00 PM.

Day 4 is hosted by Bishop Gatabazi A., with Senior Pastor Edmond Kivuye joining as the guest minister.

The day’s message is drawn from 1 John 2:27, focusing on the work of the Holy Spirit and the spiritual life of believers.

The gathering also features Glory of God W.T and Igicanira Ministry, contributing to the worship and fellowship throughout today’s program.

As the congregation moves through the seven-day journey, the Holy Convocation continues to emphasize the importance of remaining connected to God, growing in faith and allowing the Word and the Holy Spirit to shape the lives of believers.

Watch Day 4 Live

For those who cannot attend physically at Kabuga Parish, today’s gathering is also being broadcast online. through Our Youtube Channel on this Link    You are invited to join the broadcast, worship together with the congregation and follow today’s message.

Day 4 of 7 continues — a journey of faith, worship, fellowship and seeking God’s presence.
